data_api_postgrest.validation: Issues 111 and 117 must prove app and worker compatibility in non-production before issue 119 can proceed.

api_keys.reason: Anon and service-role keys are Supabase platform credentials, not backend PostgreSQL credentials.
api_keys.cutover_action: Replace service-role style access with least-privilege backend credentials and rotate Supabase keys after retirement.
